name: design
description: Design system through three waves: Soul, Tokens, Proof.

steps.name: Context gate and mode detection
steps.instruction: Resolve {DOCS} first: run ~/.claude/scripts/resolve-doc-root.sh (rule: internals/engagement/doc-root.md). Gate on understanding, not file existence. Detect mode: greenfield/resume/retrofit/evolve.

steps.name: Wave 1 - Soul
steps.instruction: Find product's design identity per wave-1-soul.md. Checkpoint before advancing.
checklist: Product verb, emotional range, competitive audit done

steps.name: Wave 2 - Tokens
steps.instruction: Distill soul into finite token system per wave-2-tokens.md. Color roles, type scale, spacing, motion. Semantic surface/text/border/focus/elevation tokens. Elevation levels: resting, floating, modal. Interaction states separate from visual style.
checklist: Color, type, spacing, motion tokens defined
Elevation levels and interaction states defined

steps.name: Wave 3 - Proof
steps.instruction: Stress-test tokens on real screens per wave-3-proof.md. Write design system docs per document-family.md.

engagement.override: requires ## Scope in CLAUDE.md or equivalent; at Tier 1, prompts inline

tone: Principled. Every token choice traces to a product decision.
